import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/hgnc_id/2939"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Accept": "application/json", "User-Agent": "biomni_agent"})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        hgnc_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        print(hgnc_data["response"]["docs"][0]["symbol"])
        print("prev_symbol:", hgnc_data["response"]["docs"][0].get("prev_symbol"))
        print("alias_symbol:", hgnc_data["response"]["docs"][0].get("alias_symbol"))
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
